summary: Special component for keyframe animation channels, built around a Keyframe CHOP and Table DATs, with CHOP input for index control and CHOP output for animated channel values.

key_params.note: Time source used for timeline-based range and rate defaults

key_params.note: Locked to Timeline, Use Input Index, Sequential, or Output Full Range

key_params.note: Jump to cue point while sequential playback is active

key_params.note: Samples, frames, seconds, fraction, or key table units for input index

key_concepts: Animation COMP is the component wrapper for authoring and playing keyframe animation channels.
Its predefined network uses a Keyframe CHOP and Table DATs to store and evaluate animated CHOP channels.
The Animation Editor is the main UI for creating and editing Animation COMP keyframes.
Without an input, the index loops over the channel range; with CHOP input, Use Input Index mode supports direct random access.
The output CHOP exposes current channel values for downstream CHOP processing or parameter export.
common_gotchas: With no CHOP input, the component's index loops over the channel time range.
Use Input Index play mode for random access playback driven by an input CHOP.
Output Full Range emits the whole animation curve and is useful for lookup curves, not current-time playback.
The CHOP output provides current values for export; append a Null CHOP for stable parameter exports.
Changing editor origin/rate affects graph display and playback interpretation, not the stored key DAT values.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ keyframe animation channel authoring and playback
